name: Mira Roses
source:
"I ask of you, from now on, please cultivate your bond."

The Archbishop and head of the Holy Church, and the principal of the Academy of Magic. Her title is equal to the King of Midir, more important than him even.

She is kind and compassionate like a saint, but also merciless when punishing the foreign enemies who threaten the Holy Church.

After learning of [url=/c135123]Sreng[/url]'s ability, she sees him as a Hero of the next generation, and entrusts him with the Bride [url=/c135124]Lia[/url].

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character_05_mira.html]official website[/url]]
